newsitem.title: UK: Coats Viyella's Bain resigns, Ost replaces.
newsitem.headline: Coats Viyella's Bain resigns, Ost replaces.

text.p: Britain's Coats Viyella Plc said on Thursday its group chief executive Neville Bain had resigned in order to pursue interests outside the group.

In a brief statement, alongside its results for 1996, the textiles group said Bain would be replaced by Michael Ost, coming to the company from McKechnie Plc where he has been chief executive for 10 years.

"I believe that Michael Ost will successfully build on the firm foundation that has been laid down over the past six and a half years and that the group will benefit from his experience and skills," group chairman David Alliance said in the statement.
The handover is expected to take place at the end of April or in early May this year.
Alliance said that the directors regretted Bain was leaving Coats Viyella but wished him well. The company gave no further details of what was descibed as Bain's "chosen interest".
